land.text: northern Henan and southern Hebei, the Henei region, given to the Zhao general Sima Ang in 206 BC

predecessors.note: No page opened says who held Henei just before; the Qin is the default predecessor of every Eighteen Kingdoms row. Sima Ang 'originally served under the insurgent Zhao kingdom' (Sima Ang page).

land.text: 'The former Kingdom of Yin became the Henei Commandery of the Han Empire' (Sima Ang page)

successors.note: 205: Han Xin conquered the kingdom; the kingdom-of-han dossier (ea-01) gains Henei in April 205.

capitals.name: Zhaoge (Qi County)
capitals.note: Sima Ang page: 'capital at Zhaoge (present-day Qi County, Henan)'. The point lies outside Cliopatria's Yin outline, which is why the drawn region adds a disc round Hebi.

correction.text: the Kingdom of Yin: 'northern Henan, southern Hebei' (Eighteen Kingdoms table); 'parts of present-day northern Henan and southern Hebei provinces' with the capital Zhaoge at Qi County (Sima Ang page); Cliopatria's shape (southern Hebei) plus a 90 km disc round Hebi for the northern Henan part

keyframe_review.note: Cliopatria's outline (14,022 km2, 73 grid cells, 69 of them in Hebei, lat 36.3-37.3 N, around Handan and Xingtai) covers only the southern Hebei half of the table's 'northern Henan, southern Hebei'. The capital Zhaoge (Qi County, 35.6 N) and the Anyang-Hebi-Xinxiang plain are outside it, so the correction adds a 90 km disc round Hebi. The years change: 206-205, not to 204. No area to compare.

ledger.note: 206: Xiang Yu makes Sima Ang King of Yin. Sima Ang page: he 'was made the King of Yin' after 'the fall of the Qin dynasty in 206 BC', reign 206-205, 'capital at Zhaoge (present-day Qi County, Henan)', territory 'parts of present-day northern Henan and southern Hebei provinces'; the Eighteen Kingdoms table agrees ('northern Henan, southern Hebei'). The year and the provinces are the pages'; the outline combines Cliopatria's shape with a disc round Hebi.

ledger.note: April-May 205: Liu Bang attacks Henei (no single month: the page says April-May). Chu-Han Contention page: 'In April-May 205 BCE, Liu Bang attacked Henei with help from Wei Bao, the King of Western Wei.' The Sima Ang page gives the conquest to Han Xin ('In 205 BC, Han Xin conquered the Kingdom of Yin').

wars.outcome: Liu Bang and Han Xin, helped by Wei Bao of Western Wei, took Henei in April-May 205; Sima Ang surrendered and the kingdom became Henei Commandery.
wars.note: The Chu-Han Contention page gives Liu Bang the attack and Wei Bao the help; the Sima Ang page gives the conquest to Han Xin. 'wei' is the Cliopatria row Wei (-404..-204), which includes Western Wei.

certainty.note: The pages give 'northern Henan, southern Hebei' and a capital, never a boundary.

sources.title: Eighteen Kingdoms
sources.note: The table of the eighteen kingdoms: Yong, Sai, Di, Yin and the others, with kings and modern territories; created by Xiang Yu in 206 BC; no capitals, no dates of fate.

sources.title: Sima Ang
sources.note: King of Yin 206-205 BC, capital Zhaoge (Qi County, Henan), conquered by Han Xin in 205, the kingdom became Henei Commandery.

sources.title: Chu-Han Contention
sources.note: Dated 205 BC for the conquest of the Three Qins, the surrender of Sima Xin, Dong Yi and Shen Yang, the attack on Henei in April-May 205, Feiqiu July-August 205.

notes: Cliopatria's Yin row (206-204) is cut to 206-205 (Han Xin's conquest, 205; the Sima Ang page). Wikidata Q5349053 is the Eighteen Kingdoms item shared by twelve rows; each is its own kingdom, none merged. Pages opened: Eighteen Kingdoms, Sima Ang, Chu-Han Contention (3 against a budget of 1-2; the third dates the attack on Henei). The Cliopatria outline sits 80 km north of the capital: the Sima Ang page's Zhaoge (Qi County, 35.6 N) is not inside it, so the corrected region adds a Hebi disc (gazetteer: 'Hebi' is a place; 'Zhaoge' and 'Qi County' are not). The Eighteen Kingdoms table's fate for Yin ('Allies with Liu Bang') conflicts with the Sima Ang page. The month of the surrender is on no page; Pengcheng is placed in September-October 205 by the Chu-Han page and 'a month later' by the Sima Ang page, which do not agree. No infobox area to compare with 14,022 km2.
